title: writable-root-args
description: A runtime's template for being handed one writable root: a non-empty list of strings with exactly one element equal to the literal {path}, and no other element containing {path}. For a node in a linked worktree, the runner appends two full expansions of this repeatable template after the runtime's args: first for the absolute common git directory, then for the absolute per-worktree git directory. Each expansion replaces {path} with that directory as one argv element, never shell-evaluated or split. Outside a linked worktree, no expansion is appended. runtimes@v0 entries and local@v0's runtime block both reference this part, so the two constraints are one.
